description: This file contains functions and types related to discovering and managing message actions and capabilities within channels, including plugin interactions, context creation, error logging, and schema handling.

methods.name: resolveMessageActionDiscoveryChannelId
methods.description: Normalizes and resolves a raw channel ID string.

methods.name: createMessageActionDiscoveryContext
methods.description: Creates a context object for message action discovery based on input parameters.

methods.name: logMessageActionError
methods.description: Logs errors encountered during message action description, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: describeMessageToolSafely
methods.description: Safely calls a plugin's describeMessageTool method, catching errors.

methods.name: normalizeToolSchemaContributions
methods.description: Normalizes schema contributions into an array.

methods.name: resolveMessageActionDiscoveryForPlugin
methods.description: Resolves actions, capabilities, and schema contributions for a plugin.

methods.name: listChannelMessageActions
methods.description: Lists all available message actions across plugins.

methods.name: listChannelMessageCapabilities
methods.description: Lists all message capabilities across plugins.

methods.name: listChannelMessageCapabilitiesForChannel
methods.description: Lists message capabilities for a specific channel.

methods.name: mergeToolSchemaProperties
methods.description: Merges schema properties from source into target.

methods.name: resolveChannelMessageToolSchemaProperties
methods.description: Resolves schema properties for message tools in a channel.

methods.name: channelSupportsMessageCapability
methods.description: Checks if a channel supports a specific message capability.

methods.name: channelSupportsMessageCapabilityForChannel
methods.description: Checks if a specific channel supports a message capability.
